ARTIFACT gap_finding: G1 is already covered by `plugins/tempergraph/docs/specs/test-suite.spec.md`. TST-B7 (lines 48-54) says that when pytest runs a test that imports the engine, from whatever folder it started in, the test gets a home folder no other test uses and that is not the real home, with nothing written in the test's package. It has three scenarios: a package with no conftest reads a temp folder, not `~/.tempergraph/`; two tests read different folders; and starting in another folder while naming the test's path still gives a temp folder. TST-AC9 (line 73) proves it for two tests in a conftest-free package folder. TST-AC11 (line 75) also names TST-B7, for the real home folder and machine index staying unchanged. TST-B8 (lines 56-61) and TST-AC10 (line 74) cover `TEMPERGRAPH_LOOP=off`, which is a different gap. The code exists: `plugins/tempergraph/engine/src/tempergraph/pytest_plugin.py` lines 13-17 has an autouse fixture that sets `TEMPERGRAPH_HOME` to `<mktemp>/.tempergraph` and `TEMPERGRAPH_LOOP` to `off` through monkeypatch. Its docstring (lines 1-6) says it loads through the `pytest11` entry point. `docs/plans/i144.plan.md` row 1.3 is marked done and adds that entry to `pyproject.toml`. The handoff `docs/tasks/i144.handoff.md` line 9 lists G1 as closed. Missing: I did not open `plugins/tempergraph/engine/tests/test_suite_isolation.py` or `pyproject.toml`, so the test that carries TST-AC9 and the entry point are unchecked.
